Hi {!Lead.FirstName}, If you asked a sampling of some of the top captive insurance agents across the country what technology they rely on most everyday, many would tell you Ricochet360's All-In-One CRM Dialer & Marketing Automation Platform. Join this joint webinar with EverQuote and Ricochet360's co-founder and CEO Beau Bratton – "Automation: Taking Your Agency to the Next Level Leveraging Ricochet LMS + EverQuote" on Thursday, June 25, 2020 @ 2:00 PM Eastern – and learn how these tools can have a major impact in your business.
During this presentation, Beau will walk you through some best practices and tactics to use when working high quality EverQuote leads, aimed at improving your:
- Speed to Contact - Contact Rate - Compliance & Layers of Protection - And overall performance
You can sign-up for the free webinar directly through our link here: https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_p08Ct7w5R42sFLTj8lJCZA
